title: Public GLiNER assertion request comparison
question: Can the caller avoid schema-prefix candidates while preserving the natural predicate anchor on the retained failure?
method: Compare current, latent and literal-only structured requests on the exact retained input under the pinned model. Exercise independently expected affirmative and negative controls and standalone classification.

outputs.role: Native request results and prefix word counts

conclusion: The retained literal-only natural request excludes enum prefix positions and returns a source-located predicate candidate. Latent grouping retains the prefix and yields no located predicate on that input. The standalone classifier makes two polarity errors on the controls. This bounds a caller-side extraction proposal and does not establish integrated semantic or full-book qualification.
